senses.definition: To replace or supplant someone in order vis-à-vis an office, position, or title.
senses.example: The king's eldest son succeeds his father on the throne.

senses.definition: To come after or follow; to be subsequent or consequent; (often with to).
senses.example: Her arms were like legs of mutton, her breasts like giant cabbages; her face, broad and fleshy, gave you an impression of almost indecent nakedness, and vast chin succeeded to vast chin.

senses.definition: To come in the place of another person, thing, or event; to come next in the usual, natural, or prescribed course of things; to follow; hence, to come next in the possession of anything; (often with to).
senses.example: Following the death of his mother, he succeeded to the throne.
